memberdef.name: replace

detaileddescription.para: replace replaces every element in the range [first, last) equal to old_value with new_value. That is: for every iterator i, if *i == old_value then it performs the assignment *i = new_value.
The algorithm's execution is parallelized as determined by exec.

memberdef.name: replace_copy

detaileddescription.para: replace_copy copies elements from the range [first, last) to the range [result, result + (last-first)), except that any element equal to old_value is not copied; new_value is copied instead.
More precisely, for every integer n such that 0 <= n < last-first, replace_copy performs the assignment *(result+n) = new_value if *(first+n) == old_value, and *(result+n) = *(first+n) otherwise.
The algorithm's execution is parallelized as determined by exec.

The beginning of the sequence to copy from.

The beginning of the sequence to copy to.

is a model of Assignable, T is a model of Equality Comparable, T may be compared for equality with InputIterator's value_type, and T is convertible to OutputIterator's value_type.
